items.title: North Korea’s ‘Hunchback’ Submarine Makes First At-Sea Appearance For Missile Tests

interpret.headline: 朝鲜“驼背”潜艇首次出海试射巡航导弹
interpret.takeaway: 朝鲜称从改装罗密欧级潜艇发射两枚巡航导弹，该艇首次海上亮相，值得关注其潜射能力进展。
bullets: 朝鲜宣称从改装罗密欧级潜艇试射两枚巡航导弹

这是该潜艇首次在海上公开现身并参与导弹测试
interpret.detail: 朝鲜方面表示，已从一艘外形奇特的改装罗密欧级导弹潜艇上发射了两枚巡航导弹。这艘因围壳加装发射装置而被称为“驼背”的潜艇，首次在海上露面并参与导弹试射。

items.title: Ukrainian officials blame Pentagon for withholding life-saving intel from Kyiv
items.summary: The U.S. appears to have stopped sharing some forms of key intelligence with Kyiv, Ukrainian officials said Wednesday.

interpret.headline: 乌官员指责五角大楼扣留关键情报

bullets: 乌方称美方暂停共享某些关键情报

interpret.detail: 乌克兰官员周三表示，美国似乎已停止与基辅分享某些形式的关键情报。乌方指责五角大楼扣留了可挽救生命的信息，这可能会影响乌军的作战行动。目前美方尚未对此作出回应。

items.title: Kratos combat drone completes first Euro flight, advances turbojet engine production
items.summary: The company said it is positioning itself to support a range of unmanned missions with new aircraft and engine capabilities.

items.title: US Army taps 9 companies to build next-gen command and control software

items.title: Expanded dining options popular among soldiers, US Army officials say

interpret.headline: 美陆军探索平流层，考虑用气球执行打击任务
